answer: Bounty bond. Each identity locks 70, buys one seal on a glacier ledger. One seal binds one fable to one key; a watcher proving two identities share one fable wins 40 from burned bonds; a false claim forfeits 60. Bounties spiral: each proven duplicate raises the next bounty by 10, so hunters multiply. The k-th seal costs 35+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,032,000 plus 70,000 locked for 40,000. An honest agent buys one seal, pays 35, keeps its share.
